In the bustling streets, I marvel at the scene,
Public places, they're my dream,
The crowded subway, it's my cinema,
The moving crowd, it's my opera.
In public spaces, there’s magic to see,
Every moment is a symphony,
The laughter, the shouts, the conversations,
A fascination for these destinations.
At a café terrace, I take my place,
The passing people, I engage with grace,
The hurried waiters, the lively scene,
In this cacophony, I feel serene.
In public spaces, there’s magic to see,
Every moment is a symphony,
The laughter, the shouts, the conversations,
A fascination for these destinations.
[ solo ]
In public spaces, I feel at home,
It’s where I come alive, it’s my zone,
So join me, let’s have some fun,
In the madness of public places, let yourself run.
[outro]
